purpose: Resolve the Palantir-Anduril integration, functional differentiation, feedback, operating-layer, competition, military-effect, and replication fog through the Army's Next Generation Command and Control record. The wave establishes an exact multi-company operating lane while preserving competition and refusing to promote one program into a system-wide founder-network conclusion.

method.null_hypothesis: a publicly directed, competitively assembled military modernization program using multiple independent vendors rather than a privately designed closed organism
method.promotion_rule: An Army record may establish the exact roles, integration, feedback, implementation, effect, or replication that it names. A bounded NGC2 result does not establish coordination across unrelated companies, funds, banks, policy organizations, or civilian-governance systems.
method.effect_rule: A live-fire training effect may establish a military operating and decision-to-effector chain in the exercise. It does not establish combat performance, a civilian population consequence, coercive governance, or wrongdoing.
method.competition_rule: A competitive alternative, continuous solicitation, or different implementation lead is retained as counterevidence and may not be reframed as proof of hidden coordination.

records.proposition: Anduril, Palantir, Raft, Lockheed Martin, and other vendors perform explicitly differentiated functions inside the bounded Army NGC2 operating architecture.

sources.title: Army and industry align on common data baseline, as NGC2 moves from prototyping to delivery

records.observation: The Army identifies Anduril as lead for the common data baseline and 4th Infantry Division full-stack implementation; Palantir as Anduril's partner providing Foundry within an edge-to-cloud data mesh alongside Lattice and deployment tools; Raft as provider of data and service registries, transformation, and federation; and Lockheed Martin as full-stack implementation lead for the 25th Infantry Division.
supports: T2 functional differentiation in one named operating program
distinct lead, platform, registry, transformation, federation, deployment, and divisional implementation roles
a source-selected multi-company organ map rather than synthetic assignment
does_not_support: a privately authored organism beyond NGC2
common ownership or governance among the vendors
the absence of redundancy or substitution
coordination with funds, banks, policy organizations, or civilian agencies
records.next_decisive_acquisition: Acquire each contract, team agreement, responsibility matrix, interface-control document, data-rights schedule, deliverable, acceptance record, subcontract, pricing term, replacement right, and alternative component for the named functions.
records.falsifier: Operative records show the named roles are marketing descriptions, were not delivered, are materially redundant, or can be replaced without the alleged differentiated closure.

records.proposition: Palantir and Anduril are technically and operationally integrated in the bounded NGC2 common data layer and 4th Infantry Division implementation.

records.proposition: The exact Palantir-Anduril NGC2 integration establishes that the full network of companies, funds, banks, policy organizations, and public agencies was jointly designed as one coordinated capture system.
records.observation: Wave 04 establishes exact cross-company differentiation, integration, feedback, bounded operating-layer implementation, military training effect, common program purpose, and intra-Army replication in NGC2. It also establishes formal competition, a Lockheed-led alternative implementation, and continuous vendor onboarding. The record does not connect NGC2 governance or operations to the broader capital, banking, policy, border, or civilian-governance estate.
